newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli army restricts Jewish militants.
newsitem.headline: Israeli army restricts Jewish militants.

text.p: The Israeli military issued orders on Thursday to 18 alleged Jewish militants restricting their movements as the army prepared to start its redeployment from the West Bank city of Hebron.

"Eighteen restriction orders were issued tonight to Jews in order to prevent friction and danger during the redeployment," a spokeswoman said, declining to give names. "Some of the orders are for four days and the rest for 10 days."

Israeli Army Radio said those targetted were Jewish ultranationalists, mostly from the West Bank, and that some lived in or around Hebron, home to some 400 Jewish settlers and more than 100,000 Palestinians.

The military has issued such orders -- restricting those who receive them to their houses or communities -- before, mainly against former members of the outlawed anti-Arab Kach movement founded by the late U.S. rabbi Meir Kahane.
